Leonida is an experimental build-it-yourself project aiming to run the Xbox Series version of Grand Theft Auto VI
on Windows from a user's own copy. It does not provide a playable release.

Leonida is a static recompilation project. The Xbox Series CPU is x86-64 like a PC, so the game's code is loaded
and run natively, and the console's system software is reimplemented. The console's precompiled RDNA2 GPU programs
are translated to SPIR-V for Vulkan. The game's models, textures and audio are read from your package. All of this
happens on your PC, from your own copy of the game .

 [!IMPORTANT]
 This repository does not contain the game, keys or an executable , and it does not explain how to get them. You
 need your own copy, with its files already readable on disk. Nothing here decrypts or works around any protection.
 Everything the build creates (the generated shaders, extracted assets, the runtime folder and your saves) comes
 from your game and stays on your PC. Never share those files.

 Project status

The table is an inherited snapshot of the original project's work, not a current compatibility report.
LeonidaReforge has not independently reproduced these historical results. The continuation does not claim a
verified retail boot or working gameplay.

 What Status 
 --- --- 
 Booting, story mode, anything playable ❌ No 
 Finding and checking your copy (Xbox Series 1.0.2.1) ✅ Works 
 Shaders: carve, unpack native RDNA2 code, disassemble ✅ All 26,503 
 Shaders: RDNA2 → SPIR-V translation ✅ 26,503 / 26,503 translated : 2,236 VS, 12,101 PS, 2,689 CS, 9,282 mesh, 195 geometry, with a per-shader metadata index for pipeline creation. The LLVM 23.1.5 Linux rerun at c432cdc and the LLVM 23.1.3 Windows rerun at 43d0015 both translated all 26,503 (Linux, Windows). Translation and SPIR-V validation are separate steps; validation results are listed below. ⚠️ 23,841 are wave64: exact on 64-wide subgroups (AMD). On 32-wide subgroups (NVIDIA, Intel), compute and mesh shaders are exact with wave64 emulation ( --wave64-emulate , on by default there); cross-half wave ops in vertex, pixel and geometry shaders are still approximate 
 SPIR-V validation ( spirv-val ) ✅ 26,503 / 26,503 passed in the LLVM 23.1.5 Linux rerun at c432cdc and in the full-corpus rerun at 43d4703 , after dcd8ecf fixed the SPIR-V ID-bound error (Linux rerun, full-corpus rerun). On Windows at 43d0015 , all 26,503 translated but 26,501 passed validation; the two ID-bound failures were fixed by dcd8ecf . The intermediate dedd75c run also passed 26,501. 
 Shader translator checked on a real GPU ⚠️ The hand-written GPU tests (vertex fetch, texture sampling, exports, ALU ops, partial-register ops, barycentrics, wave-uniform branches, compute LDS/barriers/buffer stores, wave64 masks) have been run on more than 30 GPU and driver combinations, with results in 166: NVIDIA Turing, Ampere, Ada and Blackwell (Windows and Linux); AMD GCN3, RDNA1, RDNA2, RDNA3 and RDNA4 (Windows driver and RADV); Intel Gen9 (ANV); Apple M1 (MoltenVK, no geometry or mesh stages); and Mesa llvmpipe. Wave64 tests need 64-wide subgroups (AMD) or LEONIDA W64 EMULATE=1 . These are small test shaders: the game's own shaders are checked by spirv-val and by driver pipeline creation ( vk pipeline check ), not by their output 
 Models (OBJ with real names, UVs, material references) ✅ Exported. A ten-archive scan at decoder pin e293917 recovered 382,781 models with zero readback decode failures. This includes 343,327 models from levels.rpf . A full OBJ export of that archive is pending. See recount and export scope. 
 Texture dictionaries and world texture pools (DDS) ✅ Exported. rpf9dump decodes BCPack BC1, BC3, BC4 and BC5 chunks in strict mode and skips BC6H, BC7 and chunks that need unconfirmed history; the assets stage then completes what it can with a clean-room decoder ( tools/bcpack.py , which tools/ttpf assets.py runs through tools/ttpf mips.py ) that rebuilds BC1, BC3, BC4, BC5, BC6H and BC7, and records the rest as a BCPackLimitation in manifest.json (most BC6H/BC7 chunks and the unconfirmed-history ones need a local history table, which the repo does not ship) (notes) 
 Audio banks (AWC: Opus, XMA2) ✅ Exported whole. Opus repackaged losslessly as Ogg Opus; PCM (codec 0/2) as WAV; XMA2 decoded with ffmpeg. --wav adds 16-bit PCM WAV (notes) 
 Music/radio config ? Measured. 1,589 audio-config records with exact durations and AWC stream ids; station grouping and content-id lists; no per-track start offsets (notes) 
 PE loader and import shims ⚠️ Runs a stand-in executable end to end ( gta6rt --run : CRT startup, statics, heap, files, threads, GDK imports through the shims, exit code back). Controllers through a GameInput shim on SDL3 (any controller SDL supports, rumble, DualSense trigger effects and lightbar; built when SDL3 is installed or with -DLEONIDA SDL3 FETCH=ON , notes). --trace-d3d12 logs every D3D12 call and its outcome for the first boot. Untested against the real executable 
 Xbox D3D12 → Vulkan ⚠️ In progress. A Vulkan-backed device behind the Xbox-ABI proxy creates queues, command lists, fences, descriptor heaps, committed, placed and reserved resources, render-target and depth views (
